notes: Buses (KTEL Fabrika and Old Port terminals) to the beaches cost 2 EUR; ATV or scooter 30-50 EUR; taxis are very scarce (expensive, no Uber). The airport is 4 km away.
Summer (July-August): the party island is packed; the meltemi wind makes the northern beaches rough while the south stays calm; beach club sunbeds cost 50-200 EUR. June and September are ideal.
Delos 12 + boat 22; taverna 20-30, beach club 60-100+, cocktail 15-20; one of Europe's most expensive islands; round up your tips.
Delos is closed on Mondays and has no shade, so bring water and a hat; Fokos has a dirt road (ATV); Paradise and Super Paradise parties start after 16:00.
Kopanisti (spicy cheese), louza (cured pork), kalathaki, Mykonos sandals; the Gioras bakery is 600 years old.
Sunset: Little Venice (crowded), Armenistis (quiet), 180° bar (book ahead).

stops.name: Mykonos Chora Matoyianni
stops.tips: White maze-like lanes and bougainvillea; quiet in the morning, with boutiques.

stops.name: Panagia Paraportiani
stops.tips: A whitewashed 'snowball' church formed from five chapels fused together; the island's symbol.

stops.name: Kato Mili Windmills
stops.tips: Five 16th-century windmills; views of Little Venice, best in the morning light.

stops.name: Nikos Taverna Chora
stops.tips: A family taverna since the 1980s; lamb and moussaka, with Petros the pelican passing by.

stops.name: Little Venice Sunset
stops.tips: Houses with balconies over the sea; cocktails at Caprice or Scarpa (15 EUR), and the waves splash.

backups.name: Kiki's Tavern Agios Sostis
backups.tips: A grill taverna without electricity; expect a queue, next to the beach (by vehicle).

backups.name: Aegean Maritime Museum
backups.tips: Combine with Lena's House; Tria Pigadia.

stops.name: Delos Ferry Old Port
stops.tips: The sacred island where Apollo was born; 30 minutes by boat (22 EUR return, 09:00/10:00). Closed on Mondays.

stops.name: Delos Archaeological Site
stops.tips: A UNESCO-listed Hellenistic city; Terrace of the Lions, mosaics in the House of Dionysos (with a phallus monument), the theatre. No shade.

stops.name: Mount Kynthos Delos
stops.tips: A 113 m hill with 360° views of the Cyclades; 20 minutes.

stops.name: Delos Museum Cafe
stops.tips: The only cafe; sandwiches. Return boats at 13:30/15:00.

stops.name: Agios Stefanos Beach Afternoon
stops.tips: A quiet beach near Chora; views of the ferries.

backups.name: Rinia Island Boat Tour
backups.tips: Delos's neighbour, with deserted coves; swimming and tours.

backups.name: Mykonos Old Port Cafes
backups.tips: Breakfast or lunch at the harbour; instead of the museum cafe.

days.theme: Southern beaches: Paradise and Super Paradise

stops.name: Platis Gialos
stops.tips: A family beach and starting point for water taxis; shallow sea.

stops.name: Paraga Beach
stops.tips: A small cove; Scorpios beach club (expensive, a sunset ritual).

stops.name: Paradise Beach
stops.tips: A 1970s hippie beach, now a party spot; Tropicana day party after 16:00.

stops.name: Super Paradise Beach
stops.tips: A steep cove; JackieO' beach club (LGBT-friendly), for lunch and sunbeds.

stops.name: Elia Beach
stops.tips: The island's longest quiet beach; sunbeds, and a water taxi back.

backups.name: Scorpios Paraga
backups.tips: A bohemian-luxe beach club; book ahead, a sunset ritual.

backups.name: Agrari Beach
backups.tips: Elia's quiet neighbour; reachable on foot.

stops.name: Panagia Tourliani Ano Mera
stops.tips: A monastery from 1542; marble bell tower, the island's inland village, weekend market.

stops.name: Ano Mera Square Breakfast
stops.tips: A village square cafe; loukoumades (Greek doughnuts).

stops.name: Fokos Beach
stops.tips: The island's deserted northern beach (dirt road); no facilities, natural.

stops.name: Fokos Taverna
stops.tips: The beach's only taverna; homemade Greek food, Cycladic views.

stops.name: Panormos Beach Principote
stops.tips: A stylish beach club (Principote) or the quiet end; the northern meltemi wind.

backups.name: Agios Sostis Beach
backups.tips: Fokos's neighbour; next to Kiki's taverna.

backups.name: Mykonos Vioma Organic Farm
backups.tips: Organic vineyard and tasting; Ano Mera.

stops.name: Ornos Harbour Boat Tour
stops.tips: Half- or full-day sailing boat or catamaran (about 90-150 EUR, lunch included); along the south coast.

stops.name: Dragonisi Caves
stops.tips: Sea caves and Mediterranean monk seals; snorkelling.

stops.name: Lunch on Board
stops.tips: Grilled food on deck; included.

stops.name: Swimming in Rinia Coves
stops.tips: A deserted island with turquoise coves; snorkelling.

stops.name: Return to Ornos Beach
stops.tips: Sunbeds and cocktails at Ornos; Kuzina restaurant.

backups.name: Agios Ioannis Beach
backups.tips: The Shirley Valentine beach; views of the Delos sunset, instead of Ornos.

stops.name: Rarity Gallery Chora
stops.tips: A contemporary art gallery; Kalogera.

stops.name: Folklore Museum Mykonos
stops.tips: A folk museum in a captain's house; Kastro.

stops.name: Sakis Grill House Chora
stops.tips: Souvlaki and gyros; cheap and good, Kalogera.

stops.name: Armenistis Lighthouse
stops.tips: An 1891 lighthouse on the northwest cape; views of Tinos, a sunset alternative (without the crowds).

stops.name: 180° Sunset Bar Chora
stops.tips: A hilltop bar; views of Chora and the sunset, book ahead.

backups.name: Kastro's Bar Little Venice
backups.tips: A sunset bar since 1976; classical music.

backups.name: Mykonos Brewing Company
backups.tips: Tasting of the island's beer; instead of the grill.

days.theme: Harbour morning and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Old Port Morning Fishermen
stops.tips: Petros the pelican and the fishing boats; a calm harbour.

stops.name: Gioras Wood Bakery
stops.tips: A wood-fired bakery since 1420; the island's oldest, with tiropita (cheese pie) and kalathaki.

stops.name: Chora Streets Last Walk
stops.tips: Sandals (the Mykonos sandal) and kopanisti cheese make good souvenirs.

stops.name: Mykonos Airport
stops.tips: 4 km from Chora; taxi or bus. Farewell (Piraeus ferry: New Port).

backups.name: Trio Bougatsa Chora
backups.tips: Cretan bougatsa; instead of the bakery.
